title: the program as a git clone of the product: install, align without the network, update, legacy migration
section: Proving gesture: test/distribution.test.ts, on Deno, Node and Bun: a git clone of the fixture product plus any command installs; a second host clone and a worktree align to the lock with the source gone; a new product commit plus naima update moves the lock in one commit; a lock of the old layout migrates. Red: 12 of 12 fail on main; green: 12 of 12 pass, and deno task verify, node --test and bun test pass 384 of 384.
